name: bms-analyzer
description: BMS to ordinal analyzer — C++/WASM core with Vite + TypeScript

scripts.build:wasm: em++ -std=c++20 -O3 -flto -fomit-frame-pointer -fno-exceptions -I src/cpp -lembind -o src/wasm/bms-core.js -sEXPORT_ES6 -sMODULARIZE -sEXPORT_NAME=BmsModule -sFILESYSTEM=0 -sSTACK_SIZE=512KB -sSINGLE_FILE -sENVIRONMENT=web -sDISABLE_EXCEPTION_CATCHING=1 src/cpp/bindings.cpp src/cpp/ordinal.cpp src/cpp/parser.cpp
